missions.title: Deploy a library agent to Copilot Studio
missions.summary: Takes any Copilot-Studio-ready library agent from name to published, verified agent in the user's environment — machine checks, project, components, instructions, push, publish, verification.
missions.triggers: deploy copilot studio publish build ship stand up teams production tenant environment

missions.title: Install a library agent into the local brainstem
missions.summary: Downloads any of the library's agents from the public repo and drops it into the running brainstem — live on the next message, no restart.
missions.triggers: install local locally brainstem add agent download try run

missions.title: Set up this machine for AIBAST agent work
missions.summary: Installs and checks everything a build needs: the Power Platform CLI, the one-time sign-in, the Copilot Studio plugin, and the connection to the public library.
missions.triggers: setup set up machine prerequisites prereqs install pac cli tools ready prepare onboarding start getting started

missions.title: Verify a deployed agent
missions.summary: Runs the deployed agent through its computed verification questions and reports pass/fail honestly — the difference between a demo and a liability.
missions.triggers: verify test check validate questions working proof demo ready
